title: DCAI / SQUIRL OS — Complete Public Receipts Corpus, As of 2026-10-18: 194 Ledger Entries, 93 DOI Records, Bitcoin-Anchored (Preregistrations, Runlogs, Receipts, Specs, Anchor Registry)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This work was produced inside an AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Every claim is backed by a timestamped, publicly committed receipt trail. Errors are disclosed, not erased. Limitations are load-bearing.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects. All battery payloads are synthetic.

THE COMPLETE PUBLIC RECEIPTS CORPUS of the DCAI / SQUIRL OS program, as of Oct 18 2026 — every preregistration, runlog, receipt, spec, and index from ledger entries 0001 through 0194 (ledger included verbatim, append-only from Sept 7 2026), plus the complete Bitcoin anchor registry (SIP-034 through SIP-041 chain-of-custody stack: OTS stamps, manifests, reconciliation and examiner evidence), plus the DROPBOX seed/digest drop tooling with its two permanent mainnet anchors from the same day: the patent genesis seed in block 972023 and the IP ledger digest in block 972026. A master index of all 93 Zenodo DOI records cited in the ledger is included.

Anyone can verify, three ways: (1) every DOI in the index resolves to a public Zenodo record; (2) corpus states are anchored in the Bitcoin blockchain — re-hash any anchored artifact and check the OTS stamp or OP_RETURN anchor (blocks include 971956, 971961, 972023, 972026); (3) the full commit history is public at github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. Together with the seed-mode patent genesis (keyless in-browser reconstruction at deterministic-code-dsos.base44.app/genesis-viewer) and the mainnet IP ledger anchor, this completes a three-example public verification suite: an artifact reconstructible from 32 bytes, a portfolio anchored by digest, and a full receipts corpus anchored on-chain.

Dual Mesh Benchmark status: MEASURED (scoped) — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241 (DeepSeek column); cross-engine expansion DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23348675.

Bundle SHA-256: bb0e1ca8cae3c937417942aca1fc832c130e6d662288f19883ff16c393042cd8 (138 files). Authoring correction, disclosed: the bundle was rebuilt once pre-publish to remove duplicate zip entries; the published file is the clean rebuild (bb0e1ca8...); v1's description cited the pre-rebuild sha and file count. File contents unchanged from v1.. DCAI community: zenodo.org/communities/dcai. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-18 ~11:51 CT).
